dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef001 m n is the type of real m-by-n matrices, represented as functions Fin m -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes A an m-by-n real matrix and B an n-by-p real matrix; their shared dimension n makes their matrix product well-defined.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m-by-n real matrix A, LocalDef002 A is sqrt(sum_{i in Fin m} sum_{j in Fin n} (A i j)^2), the entrywise Euclidean or Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all three scalar quantities in the inequality: the norm of the product, the norm of A, and the norm of B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: For A of size m-by-n and B of size n-by-p, LocalDef003 A B is the m-by-p matrix whose entry at (i,j) is sum_{k in Fin n} A i k * B k j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the matrix inside the left-hand norm the ordinary matrix product AB.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: HMul.hMul applies the binary operation supplied by a heterogeneous multiplication instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the specified real multiplication instance, it denotes ordinary multiplication of real numbers on the right-hand side and in the entries of the matrix product.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: LE.le applies the binary relation supplied by a less-than-or-equal instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real-order instance, it expresses that the norm of AB is less than or equal to the product of the two norms.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Nat is the type of natural numbers, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The matrix dimensions m, n, and p range over all natural numbers, so zero-dimensional cases are included.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, sums, products, square roots, norms, and both sides of the inequality are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.instLE equips the real numbers with their standard less-than-or-equal relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the conclusion its ordinary real inequality interpretation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.instMul equips the real numbers with ordinary real multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the right-hand side the ordinary real product of the two norms and makes each A i k * B k j an ordinary real product.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: instHMul converts a homogeneous multiplication structure Mul alpha into an HMul alpha alpha alpha structure using the same multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to Real.instMul, it resolves every relevant heterogeneous multiplication operation as ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite type of natural-number indices strictly less than n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the row, column, and contracted indices for the matrices and finite sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin.fintype n gives Fin n its finite enumeration containing every index exactly once.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It allows the universal finite sets used in the norm and matrix-product sums to range over all valid matrix indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finset.sum adds the values of a function over a finite set using a commutative additive monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the sums of squared entries in the norms and the contracted sum defining each entry of AB.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finset.univ is the finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each occurrence makes the corresponding sum range over every row, column, or contracted index of the indicated Fin type.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: HPow.hPow applies the exponentiation operation supplied by a heterogeneous power instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In LocalDef002 it raises each real matrix entry to the natural-number exponent 2.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix I J alpha is definitionally the function type I -> J -> alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents each matrix by its entry function and permits entries such as A i j to be evaluated directly.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Monoid.toNatPow supplies natural-number exponentiation x^n by repeated monoid multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it interprets each entry power with exponent 2 as its ordinary square.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: OfNat.ofNat obtains the value represented by a natural-number literal in a type having the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the exponent literal 2 as the natural number two.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.instAddCommMonoid supplies real addition, zero, and the commutative additive-monoid laws.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes all Finset sums ordinary finite sums of real numbers, with an empty sum equal to zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.instMonoid supplies ordinary real multiplication, one, and natural powers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the repeated-multiplication operation used to compute each real entry squared.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.sqrt is the nonnegative real square-root function; its definition sends a negative input through its nonnegative truncation, while on nonnegative inputs it is the usual principal square root.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It converts each sum of squared entries into its nonnegative square root. All inputs here are nonnegative sums of squares, so no negative-input truncation affects the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: instHPow converts a power structure Pow alpha beta into an HPow alpha beta alpha structure using the same exponentiation operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with real natural powers, it resolves the expression (A i j)^2 as ordinary squaring of a real number.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: instOfNatNat n interprets the numeral n in Nat as n itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures that the exponent appearing in every squared-entry term is exactly the natural number 2.

binders: m, n, and p are arbitrary natural numbers.
A is an arbitrary real m-by-n matrix, equivalently A : Fin m -> Fin n -> Real.
B is an arbitrary real n-by-p matrix, equivalently B : Fin n -> Fin p -> Real.
conclusions: sqrt(sum_{i in Fin m} sum_{j in Fin p} (sum_{k in Fin n} A i k * B k j)^2) <= sqrt(sum_{i in Fin m} sum_{k in Fin n} (A i k)^2) * sqrt(sum_{k in Fin n} sum_{j in Fin p} (B k j)^2).
mathematical_definitions: For any real matrix X with row index type Fin r and column index type Fin s, define N(X) = sqrt(sum_{i in Fin r} sum_{j in Fin s} (X i j)^2).
Define the m-by-p product matrix AB by (AB) i j = sum_{k in Fin n} A i k * B k j.
With these definitions, the asserted inequality is N(AB) <= N(A) * N(B), with exact multiplicative constant 1.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every choice of natural-number dimensions m, n, and p and every pair of compatible real matrices A of size m-by-n and B of size n-by-p, the square root of the sum of the squares of all entries of their matrix product is at most the product of the corresponding square-root-of-sum-of-squares quantities for A and B.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: There are no hypotheses on the entries, rank, invertibility, or signs of A and B.

The dimensions are not required to be positive. If any of m, n, or p is zero, the relevant Fin types and sums can be empty; in every such case both sides reduce to zero, so the inequality is the degenerate statement 0 <= 0 rather than a logically vacuous implication.
The proposition is restricted to finite matrices with real entries and to the explicitly defined entrywise square-root-of-sum-of-squares quantity.
The proposition asserts only the inequality with constant 1. It does not encode equality conditions, strictness conditions, optimality, an operator norm, or a generalization to other scalar types.
Although Real.sqrt is defined for all real inputs using nonnegative truncation, every radicand in this proposition is a finite sum of squares and hence nonnegative.
